name: animated-circular-progress-bar
blurb: Animated circular progress bar with primary and secondary color arcs.
description: An SVG-based circular progress indicator that animates a stroke around a circle, with primary and secondary color arcs and centered percentage text.
use_when: Displaying progress in a compact circular format, like upload/download progress or loading states.
avoid_when: When a linear progress bar is more appropriate or space is very limited.
a11y: The percentage text is displayed; the SVG itself lacks aria labels.
